name: skyline-claude
description: Wires the skyline MCP daemon into Claude Code: one HTTP MCP server, a PreToolUse enforcement hook that hard-redirects Read/Edit/Write/Grep/Glob/Bash to skyline equivalents while the daemon is running, a PreToolUse nudge (#467) that steers identifier-like skyline_grep searches on code toward the exact semantic tools without blocking, and a jobs monitor that notifies on failed, unknown-exit, or lost background jobs (routine exit-0 terminations are suppressed).
